Name: Nostalgia Filter - A Stardew Valley recolour
Author: nimzee22
Description:
[color=#c27ba0][size=4][b]~ What it is ~[/b][/size][/color][size=3]
[color=#ead1dc]Exactly what it says above!

I couldn't find a texture pack that was 100% to my liking, so I made one myself.
Heavily inspired by the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20749]Universal Recolors[/url] mod by herbivoor, but brighter than their 'extreme' preset. Also has a more pink-ish hue.

Priority for this texture pack is set to low, so if you have additional visual mods installed, they will overwrite this one.

This is my first mod, so please if you encounter any bugs or errors let me know! Feedback is much appreciated :D
[/color][/size][size=3][size=4]

[/size][left][b][color=#c27ba0][size=4]~ Install ~[/size][/color]
[/b][color=#ead1dc]Simply unzip in your mods folder.[/color][/left][color=#c27ba0]
